args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $envPath='D:\dev\tcg-watcher-worktree\.env'; $line=Get-Content -LiteralPath $envPath | Where-Object { $_ -match '^\s*MAGIC_UI_API_KEY\s*=' } | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $line) { Write-Error ('MAGIC_UI_API_KEY missing in ' + $envPath); exit 1 }; $value=($line -split '=',2)[1].Trim(); if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($value)) { Write-Error ('MAGIC_UI_API_KEY empty in ' + $envPath); exit 1 }; $env:API_KEY=$value; & npx.cmd -y @21st-dev/magic@latest
